sloka: एतस्मिन्प्लवमाने तु शिशुभावे हनूमति ।देवदानवयक्षाणां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत् ।। ७.३५.२५ ॥
transliteration: etasminplavamāne tu śiśubhāve hanūmati ।devadānavayakṣāṇāṁ vismayaḥ sumahānabhūt ।। 7.35.25 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a very great wonder arose among the gods, demons, and yakshas as this child Hanumān soared through the sky.
